H2700.def: from «02691» and «04194»; village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia:--Hazarmaveth.

H2701.def: from «02691» and «05484»; village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-susah.

H2702.def: from «02691» and the plural of «05483»; village of horses; Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine:--Hazar- susim.

H2703.def: from «02691» and a derivative of «05869»; village of springs; Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine:--Hazar- enon.

H2704.def: from «02691» and the same as «05881»; village of springs; Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-enan.

H2705.def: from «02691» and «07776»; village of (the) fox; Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine:--Hazar-shual.

H2706.def: from «02710»; an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage):--appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, × necessary, ordinance(- nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

H2707.def: a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench:--carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.def: feminine of «02706», and meaning substantially the same:--appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H2709.et: from an unused root probably meaning to bend
H2709.def: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim:--Hakupha.

H2710.def: a primitive root; properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe:--appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.def: from «02710»; an enactment, a resolution:--decree, thought.

H2712.def: or (fully) Chuwqoq {khoo-koke'}; from «02710»; appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine:--Hukkok, Hukok.

H2713.def: a primitive root; properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately:--find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2714.def: from «02713»; examination, enumeration, deliberation:--finding out, number, (un-)search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2715.def: or (fully) chowr {khore}; from «02787»; properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire (compare «02751»); hence (figuratively) noble (in rank):--noble.

H2716.et: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels
H2716.def: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels: excrement; -dung. Also chariy {khar-ee'}.

H2717.def: or chareb {khaw-rabe'}; a primitive root; to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill:-- decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, × surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

H2718.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to «02717»; to demolish:--destroy.

H2719.def: from «02717»; drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement:--axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H2720.def: from «02717»; parched or ruined:--desolate, dry, waste.

H2721.def: a collaterally form of «02719»; drought or desolation:--desolation, drought, dry, heat, × utterly, waste.

H2722.def: from «02717»; desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains:--Horeb.

H2723.def: feminine of «02721»; properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation:--decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

H2726.def: or Charbownah {khar-bo-naw'}; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Harbona, Harbonah.

H2727.def: a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed:--be afraid.

H2728.def: from «02727»; the leaping insect, i.e. a locust:--beetle.

H2729.def: a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety):--be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2731.def: feminine of «02730»; fear, anxiety:--care, × exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

H2732.def: the same as «02731»; Charadah, a place in the Desert:--Haradah.

H2733.def: patrial from a derivative of «02729» (compare «05878»); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod:--Harodite.

H2734.def: a primitive root (compare «02787»); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy:--be angry, burn, be displeased, × earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, × very, be wroth. See «08474».

H2735.et: from (02356) and a collateral (masc.) form of (01412), with the article interposed
H2735.def: from «02356» and a collateral (masculine) form of «01412», with the article interposed; hole of the cleft: Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert:--Hor-hagidgad.

H2736.def: ; from «02734» and «03050»; fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite:--Harhaiah.

H2737.et: from an unused root meaning to perforate
H2737.def: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung):--chain.

H2738.et: apparently, a pass. participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly
H2738.def: or (shortened) charul {khaw-rool'}; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed: nettle.

H2739.def: from passive participle of «02763» and «0639»; snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite:--Harumaph.

H2740.def: or (shortened) charon {khaw-rone'}; from «02734»; a burning of anger:--sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).

H2741.def: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of «02756»; a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph):--Haruphite.

H2742.def: or charuts {khaw-roots'}; passive participle of «02782»; properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager:--decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2743.def: the same as «02742»; earnest; Charuts, an Israelite:--Haruz.

H2744.def: a fuller form of «02746»; inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim:--Harhur.

H2745.def: from the same as «02775»; perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite:--Harhas.

H2747.et: from a primitive root meaning to engrave
H2747.def: from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style for writing:--graving tool, pen.

H2748.def: from the same as «02747»; a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles):--magician.

H2750.def: from «02734»; a burning (i.e. intense) anger:--fierce, × great, heat.

H2751.def: from the same as «02353»; white bread:--white.

H2752.def: from «02356»; cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean:--Horims, Horites.

H2753.def: or Chowriy {kho-ree'}; the same as «02752»; Chori, the name of two men:--Hori.

H2754.def: or charit {khaw-reet'}; from the same as «02747»; properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket:--bag, crisping pin.

H2755.et: from the pl. of (02716) and the pl. of (03123)
H2755.def: from the plural of «02716» and the plural of «03123»; excrements of doves {or perhaps rather the plural of a single word charapyown {khar-aw-yone'}; of similar or uncertain derivation, probably a kind of vegetable:--doves' dung.

H2756.def: from «02778»; autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites:--Hariph.

H2757.def: or charits {khaw-reets'}; from «02782»; properly, incisure or (passively) incised (compare «02742»); hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth): also a slice (as cut):--+ cheese, harrow.

H2758.def: from «02790»; ploughing or its season:--earing (time), ground.

H2759.et: from (02790) in the sense of silence
H2759.def: from «02790» in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind):--vehement.

H2760.def: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net:--roast.

H2761.et: a root probably allied to the equivalent of (02787)
H2761.def: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of «02787»; to scorch:--singe.

H2762.def: from «02760»; properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice:--lattice.

H2763.def: a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose:--make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

H2764.def: or (Zecheriah 14:11) cherem {kheh'-rem}; from «02763»; physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstr. extermination:--(ac-)curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.def: from «02763»; devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine:--Horem.

H2767.def: from «02763»; devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine:--Hormah.

H2768.def: from «02763»; abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine:--Hermon.

H2769.def: plural of «02768»; Hermons, i.e. its peaks:--the Hermonites.

H2771.def: from «02787»; parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place:--Haran.

H2772.def: patrial from «02773»; a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim:--Horonite.

H2773.def: dual of a derivative from «02356»; double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab:--Horonaim.

H2774.def: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite:--Harnepher.

H2775.et: from an unused root meaning to scrape
H2775.def: or (with a directive enclitic) charcah (khar'- saw}; from an unused root meaning to scrape; the itch; also (perhaps from the mediating idea of «02777») the sun:--itch, sun.

H2776.def: the same as «02775»; shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine:--Heres.

H2777.et: from (02775) (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping)
H2777.def: from «02775» (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem:--east.

H2778.def: a primitive root; to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; denominative (from «02779») to spend the winter:--betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.def: from «02778»; properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age:--cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2781.def: from «02778»; contumely, disgrace, the pudenda:--rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.

H2782.def: a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide:--bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2783.et: from a root corresponding to (02782) (sense of vigour)
H2783.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02782» in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength):--loin.

H2784.def: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain:--band.

H2785.def: from «02782»; a sour grape (as sharp in taste):--kernel.

H2786.def: a primitive root; to grate the teeth:--gnash.

H2787.def: a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion:--be angry, burn, dry, kindle.

H2789.et: a collateral form mediating between (02775) and (02791)
H2789.def: a collateral form mediating between «02775» and «02791»; a piece of pottery:--earth(-en), (pot-)sherd, + stone.

H2790.def: a primitive root; to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness):--X altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

H2791.def: from «02790»; magical craft; also silence:--cunning, secretly.

H2793.def: from «02790»; a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric):--bough, forest, shroud, wood.

H2794.def: active participle of «02790»; a fabricator or mechanic:--artificer.

H2796.def: from «02790»; a fabricator or any material:--artificer, (+) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, + mason, skilful, (+) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H2797.def: from «02792»; magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim:--Harsha.

H2798.def: plural of «02796»; mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem:--Charashim, craftsmen.
